subject: CareVista Pilot: Sales→Success passoff & rollout cadence
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@carevista.com>
Cc: Jeffrey Park <jeff.park@carevista.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: CareVista Pilot: Sales→Success passoff & rollout cadence

Hi team,

Thanks for the close work on CareVista (Deal DEAL-4871). Attaching final SOW (v3) and the onboarding canvas. Key context below:
- Contract value: $450k ARR, 12-month pilot (vetted by Legal)
- Target go-live: 2026-10-12 (pilot acceptance gates required)
- Integrations: nightly SFTP for batched exports; optional API stream (engineering prefers webhook)
- Data residency: US-only; customer asked for SOC 2 evidence and retention details

Asks for Sales→CS passoff: 
1) CS primary owner + backup
2) Confirm kickoff window (proposed 2026-09-14 to 2026-09-16)
3) Tech owner for integration and expected API SLA

I've included the onboarding canvas and SOW. Naomi will stay on for the first two weeks of the pilot for escalation and acceptance criteria clarification.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachment: carevista_sow_v3.pdf [application/pdf], onboarding_canvas.xlsx [application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet])

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@carevista.com>, Jeffrey Park <jeff.park@carevista.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CareVista Pilot: Sales→Success passoff & rollout cadence

Thanks Naomi — great summary. Looping in Monica as primary CS owner and Logan (cc in follow-up) as technical implementation lead. Monica — can you confirm ownership? Proposed kickoff window works for us; if you prefer, we can do a one-hour pre-kick call the week prior to align resources.

Preliminary owner assignments (IMO):
- CS primary: Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwood.com)
- CS backup: Marissa Cole
- Tech lead (integration): Logan Wright (assigning formally once he confirms)

Monica, if you can take point on the intake checklist and confirm availability for a 60-minute kickoff on one of: 9/14, 9/15, 9/16 (PST). Also calling out we should validate the SFTP footprint and whether they need a private endpoint.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CareVista Pilot: Sales→Success passoff & rollout cadence

Quick technical notes for the team — copying Logan as potential owner for integration engineering: 
- SFTP: we need their expected file sizes and retention policy. If >50GB/day we'll recommend streaming or chunked uploads.
- API/webhook: CareVista's engineering mentioned webhooks are preferred. We need a public endpoint and a basic auth token or signed headers; SSO not required for pilot.
- Test data: ask CareVista for a 14-day test feed (anonymized) and a sample record schema.

Logan — can you confirm if your team can provision a private ingress (VPC peering) if they require it? If not, we should capture that as an action in the kickoff.

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@carevista.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jeffrey Park <jeff.park@carevista.com>
Date: 2026-09-05T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CareVista Pilot: Sales→Success passoff & rollout cadence

Thanks Naomi and team — appreciate the clear summary. A few quick clarifications from CareVista: 
- SOC 2: we asked for scope that covers processing and hosting (US region). Can you share the specific evidence/document and the retention policy?
- SFTP details: we'll share expected file sizes next week but likely ~10-20GB/day for initial pilot.
- Kickoff: 9/15 works for our ops/eng. Prefer 10am PT.

Also tagging our engineering contact Jeff Park for any API/webhook specifics.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lin
Head of Operations, CareVista Health

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@carevista.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jeffrey Park <jeff.park@carevista.com>
Date: 2026-09-05T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CareVista Pilot: Sales→Success passoff & rollout cadence

Hi Sarah — quick answers and next steps: 
- SOC2 evidence: attaching "security-answers.pdf" which includes our SOC 2 Type II report excerpt and a summary of data residency controls. We also maintain an audit log export for customer requests — retention policy is 90 days by default; we offer extended retention as an add-on.
- File sizes: 10-20GB/day is fine for the pilot. Karthik/Logan — please validate batch window and whether we'll hit memory limits for the parser.
- Kickoff: locked for 2026-09-15 at 10:00 AM PT. Monica, please send calendar invite with agenda and pre-kick checklist.

Related links:
- Onboarding canvas: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-carevista-onboard-canvas
- HubSpot: HS-DEAL-4871

Naomi
(attachment: security-answers.pdf [application/pdf])

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@carevista.com>, Jeffrey Park <jeff.park@carevista.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CareVista Pilot: Sales→Success passoff & rollout cadence

Confirmed — Monica has accepted ownership and will lead the kickoff on 9/15 10:00 AM PT. Action items before kickoff (owners):
- Monica: send calendar invite + agenda + pre-kick checklist by EOD 9/06 (IN PROGRESS)
- Logan: confirm SFTP memory/parser limits and whether a private ingress is required (due 9/08)
- Karthik: provide sample schema template and validation script to CareVista (due 9/09)
- Naomi: remain on standby for first two weeks for acceptance questions

I'll open a shared implementation channel in Slack and create a small Confluence playbook from the onboarding canvas to track tasks. Thanks everyone — good handoff.

- Marissa
Senior Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
